description: This Java source file defines the Receiver class, a Spring component for a command-line client that receives messages via Hono's northbound Telemetry and Event APIs. It includes methods for establishing connections, creating consumers based on message type, handling incoming messages, and managing connection restarts.

classes.name: Receiver
classes.description: A Spring component class that implements a message receiver client for Hono's telemetry and event APIs, managing connection, message consumption, and reconnection logic.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the receiver, establishes connection, monitors and creates message consumers based on message type.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates message consumers for telemetry and/or event messages based on the configured message type.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes received messages by extracting device id, payload, and logging message details.

methods.name: handleCreateConsumerStatus
methods.description: Handles the result of the consumer creation process, logging success or error, and closing the connection on failure.
